question: What is the essence of the goddesses and what follows?
premises: Their essence is unlimited consciousness alone.
Then all limbs, faces, and so on, world-guardians, weapons, last.
inference: The goddesses are unlimited consciousness-essence for liberation, followed by limbs, faces, guardians, weapons, and last items.
uncertainties: The exact relation of sarvaṃ to the following compound is compressed.
plain_english: Their essence is unlimited consciousness alone, for liberation; then all limbs, faces, and so on, world-guardians, weapons, last.
